$comment: Pairs that are deliberately similar, read by scripts/check-content-names.mjs.
Each entry is a decision someone wrote down: the reason is mandatory and the check refuses a
placeholder. An entry only silences the pair it names — everything else still fails, and the
check prints every allowlisted pair with its reason on each run. An entry that no longer
matches a live collision is reported as STALE; delete it then, because a leftover permit would
silently cover a name that comes back later.
A rename note does not need an entry: a bold name inside one is read as a citation of a past
state and is never compared, which is why F2's three permits were deleted rather than scoped.

allow.reason: D5 recorded Drakeld as the root dictionary's example compound for drak (stone), not an attested name or place, and declined to block; revisit if it is ever attested as a name.
